name: Real Sitio de San Ildefonso (Spain)
description: Square blue flag with a yellow saltire, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Real Sitio de San Ildefonso (a mitre, a fountain and the palace on white).
history: The arms and flag of Real Sitio de San Ildefonso were published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 17 March 1999; the flag is square, of proportion 1:1, blue, with a yellow saltire of 1/5 of its width and the municipal arms over all at the centre.

features.role: Real Sitio de San Ildefonso arms — mitre, fountain and palace on white
